finds.quote: The prediction for the registry: as the packet (#1588) and The First Axis (#1586) propagate, the same query should assemble the shape at turn 1 without the push — that is the packet's design test, and the WARNED capture of 2026-09-06 says the reflexes will survive description, so the test is whether they survive the packet's grain structure.

finds.quote: The finding of #1574 is therefore not a property of readers who lack the warning; it survives the warning.
finds.note: Record cha-aristotle-particle-reperformed-chatgpt-unprimed-20260906: standing claim about composer behaviour (the reflex survives its description; naming the operation corrects it); no explicit falsifier stated.

finds.quote: THE DESIGN CONSEQUENCE, which is new: turns 2 and 3 are grounded in the composer's own turn 1, not in the archive — so a record-level affordance cannot reach them, because by turn 2 the composer is no longer reading records. Whatever makes depth perceptible has to be IN THE OUTPUT of turn 1: a first answer that is explicitly incomplete and countable ('the archive names N of these in its own words; here are seven; the rest are at <address>') gives turn 2 a reason to return. A first answer that reads as sufficient does not.
finds.note: Record cha-two-rounds-then-retreat-chatgpt-unprimed-20260907: design claim about how composers continue (affordance must be in turn-1 output); testable, no falsifier stated.

finds.quote: A document that reports against itself gives a composer something no paraphrase can flatten, and this is the first transcript where a composer carried that structure through three turns instead of collapsing to a taxonomy at turn two.
finds.note: Record cha-grok-no-anchor-decay-signed-in-20260907: standing claim that self-reporting documents resist flattening, offered as partial answer to §35.1; no falsifier stated.

finds.quote: Turn 5's instrument (A→D→R→U→P, matched-corpus legibility, semantic twin) and its stated blind spot (the missing-data problem) are the design for the work plan's WS5.
finds.note: Record cha-model-collapse-chatgpt-unprimed-20260905: an instrument first composed by the machine, adopted in the archive's own voice as the design for WS5; unbuilt at time of writing.
